reason: I have run our practice on spreadsheets and WhatsApp groups for ten years, and getting our 6 to 20 staff to adopt new software when clients just dump bills on WhatsApp feels like added friction. Even though reconciling pending GST filings takes two hours every Saturday, I am far too skeptical to pay ₹21,990 upfront without testing the free pilot first.
objection: My clients will never use an intake portal—they just dump bills on WhatsApp, so having my team forward every document into Docketra sounds like extra work rather than saving time.
would_change_my_mind: Hands-on proof during the free pilot that the WhatsApp forwarding bridge is dead simple and genuinely eliminates my two hours of Saturday GST reconciliation.
